captions.caption: With its intimate acoustic guitar intro and soft yet deeply emotional male vocals, this minimalistic folk song gradually builds with subtle percussion, evoking a sense of raw vulnerability and introspection, making it the perfect soundtrack for a quiet, introspective moment.

Acoustic guitar brings in a rueful tune to begin; finger-picking provides accompaniment to a male vocalist who sings a pretty and lamenting tune that reminds me of a song that would be played at the end of a drama TV show while a montage plays.
